data.title: AG Girişim Holding Slightly Increases Stake in Merko Gıda
data.description:
The latest update is out from Merko Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. Class A ( (TR:MERKO) ).

AG Girişim Holding A.Ş., a privileged shareholder of Merko Gıda Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş., purchased 50,000 additional shares on September 18, 2026, at prices between 1.06 and 1.10 Turkish lira, with an average of 1.08 lira. Following this transaction, AG Girişim’s stake in Merko’s capital rose slightly to 150,958,378.09 shares, representing 17.76% of the company’s equity, while its voting rights remained at 32.72%, signaling continued confidence and a modest increase in its ownership position.

The transaction underscores a marginal but notable reinforcement of AG Girişim’s influence in Merko, as its equity share in the company’s capital edged up from 17.75% to 17.76%. Although the change in ownership is small in percentage terms, it reflects ongoing shareholder support and may be interpreted by the market as a sign of stability in the company’s governance and capital structure.

data.title: Turkish Regulator Orders Suspension and Liquidation of Funds Linked to Güler Yatırım Holding
data.description:
The latest update is out from Guler Yatirim Holding A.S. ( (TR:GLRYH) ).

Güler Yatırım Holding reported that Türkiye’s Capital Markets Board has ordered investment funds established by its shareholder Pardus Portföy and indirectly held A1 Capital Portföy, and traded on the Türkiye Electronic Fund Trading Platform, to be closed to trading and subsequently liquidated under procedures to be set by the regulator. As a result, purchases and sales in these funds have been suspended, and the liquidation process will follow applicable legislation, regulatory principles, and fund information documents.

The company stated that Pardus Portföy and A1 Capital Portföy are working closely with the capital markets regulator and other authorities to ensure full compliance with the decision. Güler Yatırım Holding emphasized that its corporate operations and group activities continue uninterrupted, urged investors to rely solely on its official communication channels and competent authorities for information, and pledged to keep the market informed as developments unfold in line with its transparency commitments.
